markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (59%)** · Confident · Careful review
Invasive risk is 40% on a stain-degraded simulated frozen section with tumor called at all four margins [F7].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Top probabilities | InSitu 59%, Invasive 40%, Benign 0%, Normal 0% [F1] | Close split; invasion not excluded |
| Conformal set | {InSitu} at 90% target (90% test coverage, n=132) | Single class; dataset-level guarantee only |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% reliability, 100th OOD percentile, 12 regions kept [F6] | Unflagged, despite extreme OOD stain |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Agree on top class | Independent models match each other |
| Similar cases | 2/5 InSitu, 3/5 Invasive (82%–84% similarity) [F5] | Majority of neighbors are Invasive |

## Tissue evidence
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (regions 2, 5, 6) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score (-0.59 contribution) opposing invasion; 12/20 AI spot check [F2] · Weak
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 4, 7, 9) · ↑ invasive · Above-typical score (+0.52 contribution), but 0/20 AI spot check [F3] · Unreliable
- **Tumor necrosis** (regions 2, 6, 9) · ↑ invasive · Above-typical score (+0.44 contribution), but 3/20 AI spot check [F4] · Unreliable
- **Gland / tubule formation** (region 0) · ↑ invasive · Low score pushes toward invasion (+0.32); 18/20 spot check, caption-inconsistent · Weak
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (region 0) · ↑ invasive · Low score pushes toward invasion (+0.31 contribution); 20/20 AI spot check · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful; deleting top-3 risk regions drops invasive score more than random (+0.0114, 95% CI 0.0021–0.0197, n=132).
- **Concepts**: Unproven (+0.0008 vs random; 95% CI -0.0088–0.0064 includes 0); leans on Unreliable mitoses (0/20) and necrosis (3/20).

## Could be wrong if
- High-risk regions 10 (86% risk) or 8 (58% risk) harbor true stromal invasion, matching 3/5 Invasive similar cases.
- Simulated frozen-section severity-3 stain degradation (100th OOD percentile) distorts class probabilities or false-positive calls on all four margins.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 10, 8, 5**: Highest heatmap invasive risk (86%, 58%, 46%); inspect to exclude frank stromal invasion.
2. **Regions 2, 5, 6**: Top duct-confined regions; confirm duct confinement versus tumor infiltrating stroma in region 6.
3. **Regions 4, 7, 9**: Verify claimed mitoses and necrosis manually, and inspect all four surgical margins (323–538 µm).
